proposals.evidence: Turner *laḍikka gives Punjabi laṛkā, western Pahari laṛkā and Kumauni laṛīk alongside Hindi laṛkā/laṛkī. The Jaunsari diminutive -ṭo/ṭu and Hindi feminine expansion are retained. This is a family assignment: Turner himself allows some forms alternatively under the doubled *laḍḍikka branch, so the deeper consonant history is not claimed to be certain.
